declaration.hidden_update_rule: Each cell carries a refractory/phase bit that flips when the cell changes, so the next visible state depends on whether a currently identical-looking cell was recently alive or dead.
declaration.mechanism: The visible dynamics are not first-order in the shown binary frame; they are a period-2, Life-like outer-totalistic cellular automaton on the 32x32 torus where the same visible pattern can evolve differently depending on this hidden per-cell phase. Empirically, simple seeds show strong two-step alternation and delayed expansion, indicating the rule is effectively second-order rather than ordinary memoryless Life.
